**East West University Scholarship Policy and Guidelines**

The scholarship policy at East West University (EWU) is designed to support meritorious and financially constrained students. Below are the key components of the scholarship rules, regulations, and procedures, including all conditions and exceptions:

1. **Types of Scholarships**:
   - **Merit Scholarships**: Awarded to students based on their academic performance.
   - **Financial Assistance**: Available for students who demonstrate financial need.
   - **Sibling/Spouse Benefit**: If two siblings or a husband-wife study simultaneously at EWU, the second sibling/spouse is entitled to a half-tuition waiver, provided both are admitted full-time into regular programs and study within the stipulated time for completing their degrees.

2. **Eligibility Criteria**:
   - **General Eligibility**: All scholarships are subject to the fulfillment of admission and other criteria set by EWU.
   - **Merit Scholarship**: Candidates scoring GPA 5.00 (including the 4th subject) in the immediate past SSC and HSC examinations will be awarded a 50% merit scholarship at entry level in undergraduate programs for the first year, subject to qualifying in the EWU Admission Test and maintaining a minimum GPA of 3.50 in each semester as a regular student.
   - **Financial Aid for Employees**: Employees of EWU who study at EWU will be granted a 50% tuition fee waiver but must maintain a minimum passing CGPA of the respective degree/program for continuation of the financial benefit.

3. **Conditions for Continuation**:
   - To continue receiving scholarships or financial aid, students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.60 calculated on the basis of grades earned in the last three consecutive semesters or one year.
   - Students must register for a minimum number of credits each semester: at least 12 credits for B.Pharm. students and at least 9 credits for other undergraduate students.

4. **Application Process**:
   - Students must apply for scholarships during the admission process. The application must include all required documents and meet the deadlines specified by the university.
   - A committee will assess and recommend scholarship/financial aid to students from overseas and those coming from other educational backgrounds.

5. **Restrictions**:
   - No student is entitled to benefit from more than one scholarship/financial assistance scheme at any point in time.
   - Students availing the advantage of retaking any course at any time will not be eligible for any scholarship.

6. **Special Provisions**:
   - The university reserves a 3% admission quota for the wards of freedom fighters of all categories, subject to fulfilling the admission criteria.
   - The continuation of any scholarship is contingent upon maintaining the required CGPA and abiding by the university’s Code of Conduct.

7. **Disciplinary Code**:
   - Students must adhere to the East West University Disciplinary Code for Students at all times. Violations may result in the discontinuation of financial aid.

This scholarship policy aims to nurture merit and provide financial support to deserving students, ensuring that education at EWU remains accessible to all qualified candidates.

**East West University Policies and Scholarship Guidelines**

The policies at East West University (EWU) encompass various aspects of academic and administrative operations, including scholarship provisions aimed at supporting meritorious and financially constrained students. Below are the key components of the scholarship rules, regulations, and procedures, including all conditions and exceptions:

### **Scholarship Types and Conditions**

1. **Merit Scholarships**:
   - Awarded to students based on academic performance.
   - Students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 3.50 to continue receiving the scholarship.
   - Scholarships are available for both undergraduate and graduate programs.

2. **Need-Based Financial Assistance**:
   - Designed for students who demonstrate financial need.
   - Students must apply and provide necessary documentation to qualify.
   - Continuation of financial aid is subject to maintaining a minimum CGPA of 2.60.

3. **Tuition Waivers for Siblings**:
   - If two siblings are enrolled at EWU, the second sibling is entitled to a 50% tuition fee waiver.
   - Both siblings must be admitted full-time into regular programs and must study within the normal study time required for their respective programs.

4. **Foreign Students**:
   - Foreign students may receive a 50% tuition waiver.
   - A committee will assess and recommend scholarship/tuition fee/financial aid to students from overseas and those from different educational backgrounds.

5. **Top Scorers**:
   - The top 10% of students from each batch who have completed at least one-fourth of the total credit requirement may be eligible for additional scholarships.

6. **Conditions for Scholarship Continuation**:
   - Students must register for a minimum number of credits each semester (9 credits for undergraduate students, 12 credits for B. Pharm students).
   - Students availing of the advantage of retaking any course at any time will not be eligible for any scholarship.

7. **Application Process**:
   - Students must apply for scholarships during the designated application period.
   - Documentation proving academic performance and financial need must be submitted.

### **General Policies**

- **Disciplinary Code**: All students must abide by the East West University Disciplinary Code for Students at all times.
- **Tuition and Fees**: EWU reserves the right to revise its tuition and other fees at its discretion.
- **Academic Performance**: Students must maintain satisfactory academic performance to remain eligible for scholarships and financial aid.

These policies are designed to ensure that deserving students have access to quality education while maintaining the standards of academic excellence at East West University. 

For further details, please refer to the official EWU documents or contact the admissions office.

**Freedom Fighters’ Scholarship Policy at East West University**

As a mark of respect to the valiant Freedom Fighters of the War of Liberation and Independence, East West University (EWU) has established the following scholarship provisions:

1. **Admission Quota**:
   - The university reserves a **3% admission quota** for the wards of Freedom Fighters of all categories, **subject to their fulfillment of the minimum admission requirements at East West University** [Page 107, Source: EWU_Complete_Data_2025_2026.pdf].

2. **Tuition Waiver**:
   - EWU considers a **maximum 100% tuition waiver scholarship** for the wards of wounded, deceased, and financially distressed Freedom Fighters, **subject to the fulfillment of the following requirements**:
     - The candidate must qualify in the EWU admission test.
     - The candidate must provide proof that his/her parent was a Freedom Fighter [Page 107, Source: EWU_Complete_Data_2025_2026.pdf; Page 222, Source: ewuundergraduate-bulletin-14th-edition-doc-version.pdf].

3. **Conditions for Continuation**:
   - The tuition fee waiver will continue provided that the CGPA in each semester remains **2.60 or more**. 
   - To continue receiving financial assistance, all undergraduate students must register for at least **3 courses (9 credits)** in a semester; this credit requirement is **4 courses (12 credits)** in a semester for students of the B.Pharm and LL.B Programs. For graduate programs, the requirement is at least **2 courses (6 credits)** [Page 107, Source: EWU_Complete_Data_2025_2026.pdf].

4. **Exclusions**:
   - Such scholarships and financial assistance, including family concessions and Freedom Fighter scholarships, are **not available to those students who have already spent the regular study time required for the programs for which they are enrolled** (e.g., Bachelor’s degree program students are not eligible for any scholarship/financial aid beyond the four years required to complete the course as a regular student) [Page 107, Source: EWU_Complete_Data_2025_2026.pdf].

This scholarship policy aims to honor the contributions of Freedom Fighters while providing educational opportunities to their families. 

[CONFIDENCE: HIGH]
